hook_spec.mechanism: Search::inctx_probe(child_key, child_context) (src/search/dfpn/mod.rs): env-gated (ATOMIC_INCTX=1, read once at Search::new) probe of the plan9 repetition cache at evaluate_child's unsolved site — between the terminal classification and the unsolved-bounds/(1,1) fallback, after the TT resolved-result check; ordering mirrors dfpn exactly (TT resolved -> terminal -> rep-cache probe -> unsolved bounds -> (1,1)); the hit is NOT depth-guarded, matching dfpn's frame-entry probe. On a hit: ChildInfo { outcome: Some(Draw), (pn, dn) = Draw.pn_dn_for(child_is_or), depth = cached_depth, repetition_seen: true, explored: false } — repetition_seen makes a parent draw proven through this child itself repetition-dependent (first-player-loss suppression stays correct). Child context derived O(1) per dfpn frame as context_hash + mix(rep_key) (both loop-invariant locals) and passed to evaluate_all_children/evaluate_child (one extra u64 parameter; no Search field, no per-probe stack recompute). The rep-cache itself is untouched (keying, capacity, plan9 store sites, clear-per-run semantics); a hit consumes no child-eval budget beyond the evaluate_child call it answers (same accounting as the TT-resolved path).
hook_spec.soundness: per the repetition_cache.rs plan9 contract: only proven repetition-dependent Draws ever enter the cache and a hit requires the exact (tt_key, context) pair — the reuse is the precise value a fresh re-descent would recompute under the identical ancestor set (the path stack is identical across the parent's loop). The rejected alternative (frame-local outcome memoization) is unsound in its naive form: a max_depth-capped leaf returns Draw WITHOUT a proof (core.rs leaf store), so an outcome-memo converts an unproven frontier into a proven draw.
hook_spec.coverage: the probe fires at both re-evaluation surfaces — the loop's children[idx] re-eval (the C8 site) and evaluate_all_children's first-sweep table build (a C8-superset); both production call sites funnel through evaluate_child (the lean-plan12 prefetch pre-pass reads no values).
